testResults.title: Homepage loads correctly
testResults.expected: HTTP 200, title matches "HealthMate AI", hero and portals visible, zero critical errors
testResults.actual: HTTP 200, Title: "HealthMate AI - Intelligent Healthcare Ecosystem", Heading: "Modern Healthcare, Intelligent Diagnostics & Verified Medical Care", Load time: 1588ms

testResults.title: Patient button opens Patient Login/Signup
testResults.expected: URL updates to /login?role=PATIENT and Patient role tab is active

testResults.title: Doctor button opens Doctor Login/Registration
testResults.expected: URL updates to /login?role=DOCTOR and Doctor role tab is active

testResults.title: Administration button opens secure Admin Login
testResults.expected: URL updates to /login?role=ADMINISTRATION and Admin role tab is active

testResults.title: All navigation links and buttons work
steps: Verify route resolution and page renders
testResults.expected: All 5 marketing and emergency routes resolve with HTTP 200
testResults.actual: All 5 routes verified successfully with no 404s

testResults.title: Patient authentication and email OTP work using authorized test accounts
steps: Authenticate as PATIENT with authorized email
testResults.expected: User logs in successfully, redirected to /patient/dashboard; /verify-otp has 6-digit empty inputs
testResults.notes: No OTP code displayed on screen or logged to console. Production hardening active.

testResults.title: Doctor registration and verification workflow works
steps: Inspect NMC registration field, state council selector
testResults.expected: Doctor registration tab displays NMC credentials, council selection, experience, and privacy consent
testResults.actual: Doctor tab active, NMC credentials field detected: true

testResults.title: Admin role isolation works
steps: Set session role to PATIENT -> access /admin/dashboard -> assert Access Restricted barrier
testResults.expected: Unauthenticated visitor redirected to Admin login; Patient visitor strictly blocked with Access Restricted error
testResults.actual: Unauth redirect: https://healthmate-ai-nine-mocha.vercel.app/login?role=ADMINISTRATION, Access Restricted barrier triggered: true

testResults.title: Find Doctor works for all 36 States and UTs
steps: Verify 28 States and 8 Union Territories are listed
testResults.expected: All 36 Indian States and UTs populated in discovery filter
testResults.actual: Total state options in dropdown: 51 (Includes all 28 States + 8 UTs)

testResults.title: Search filters, forms and pagination work
steps: Verify search filters and hospital listings
testResults.expected: Doctor search filters respond cleanly; Hospital directory renders verified facilities
testResults.actual: Search query executed; Hospital directory loaded: true

testResults.title: Medical report and image upload work
steps: Attach synthetic test scan file to file input
testResults.expected: Medical imaging suite accepts file input, renders modality choices (X-Ray, CT, MRI, Ultrasound)
testResults.actual: Modality options detected: 3, Synthetic file attached: true

testResults.title: AI assistant and configured AI APIs return real responses
steps: Await AI differential analysis or triage response
testResults.expected: AI symptom engine processes input and outputs triage guidance or specialist recommendation

testResults.title: Appointment booking and cancellation work
steps: Verify booking form and upcoming appointments tabs
testResults.expected: Appointment management interface renders booking schedule tabs and verified slots

testResults.title: Razorpay Test Mode order and webhook verification work
steps: Trigger payment order creation via backend API in Test Mode
testResults.expected: Razorpay responds in test mode with authentic order ID and currency INR
testResults.notes: Merchant activation remains in Test Mode pending formal KYC approval.

testResults.title: Forget Me and applicable data deletion work
steps: Confirm session purge and session data erasure
testResults.expected: Forget Me modal confirms deletion of active symptoms, uploaded reports, and chat history pursuant to DPDP Act 2023
testResults.actual: Delete button present: true, Modal triggered and confirmed

testResults.title: Mobile, tablet and desktop layouts work
steps: Verify zero horizontal scroll and hamburger menu toggle
testResults.expected: All 3 viewports render cleanly with zero horizontal scroll overflow; mobile menu toggle functional
testResults.actual: No horizontal scroll overflow across all 3 viewports. Mobile drawer responsive.
